other_errors_seen: Dead trip-count code left behind: getLoopTripCount/computeCount emit the count (and F007's guard) into the preheader before convertToHardwareLoop checks the exit blocks, so a loop rejected afterwards ('multiple loop exit blocks') keeps ~10 dead instructions in the final assembly (e.g. logs/20-F020/v_ult.ll bb.4: li/sub/sltu/neg/and/addi, never used). No DCE runs after the pass. Code size/cycle waste, pre-existing (ref-18 leaves the SUB too); P3.

review_fix: Reviewer finding (tasks/20/F020.review.json): the substituted end immediate -2048 in a count-down loop became Start after the swap and was emitted as ADDI x, 2048 (illegal, silently encoded as -2048, the loop hangs). Revision 2 repeats the immediate range check after the swap (Start: isInt<12>(imm) && isInt<12>(-imm); End: isInt<12>(imm)) and declines the loop otherwise. Only count-down loops with end constant exactly -2048 are affected. The note now says the substitution opens this new path (previously End immediates came only from imm5 branches, -16..15) and explains how it is range-checked.
